serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Listen lady, I may be stupid, but I’m not as stupid as you think I am. Never call me again you scamming piece of shit!
Some woman: Oh really you cuckold?! Fuck you! I made thousands of dollars this way! THOUSANDS! You sound broke anyway! 
You: Bitch! I will tell the cops on you!
Some woman: Ha! Good luck trying! They will never get me!
Some woman: *hangs up*
You: Bitch!
What a disgusting creature! Does she really think someone would fall for it?
This was a waste of time all the way.
